principles: current story Koala artifacts are metadata-only
legacy and runtime storage paths must be compatible during migration
source and other-story changes must remain stale
drivers: BUG-1 remains when committed test-evidence/test-runs path is legacy or migration-adjacent
storage migration cannot assume every project instantly moved all stories
existing fixture covers configured .koala path but not legacy path under new config

options.name: A: recognize both configured and canonical legacy/current story prefixes
B: infer current story metadata by filename anywhere
cons: too broad; could hide unrelated test-evidence files

options.name: C: require all projects migrate before DONE
cons: does not help active old projects and creates migration cliff

chosen: A: recognize both configured and canonical legacy/current story prefixes
rationale: 选择 A，因为它精确限定 storyId 目录，同时兼容 .koala/story/actives 和 docs/story/actives 两套真实路径，不会放宽到任意文件名。

preMortem.scenario: 其它 story artifact 被误豁免
preMortem.trigger: prefix 判断只看 actives 不看 storyId
preMortem.consequence: 另一个 story 改动不会触发 retest
preMortem.mitigation: prefix 必须包含当前 storyId

preMortem.trigger: 分类器把整个 .koala 或 docs 目录放行
preMortem.mitigation: 只放行当前 story metadata 目录和 activity log 精确路径

preMortem.consequence: 用户继续遇到 BUG-1 loop
